input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Deepen flagship ai-bookkeeper (allocate.py row 1): scanned (image-only) statement PDFs and page photos read by OCR, checked and repaired from the statement's own balances
errors: Ran three tesseract processes at once on 4 cores (a debug read alongside the benchmark); OpenMP oversubscription slowed each page from ~5 s to over 6 min. Killed them and ran OCR one at a time after that.

The first benchmark table compared different images: ImageMagick +noise was unseeded, and the generator printed negative balances without a minus. Seeded it, fixed it, and dropped that comparison from the README.

An early repair rule 'fixed' a correct first row against an opening balance the reader had mis-taken from a one-line 'Beginning ... Ending ...' summary. Fixed the reader, and the first row is no longer repaired against the opening alone.

The real-scan unit test was flaky: it used unseeded ImageMagick noise, and OCR of a tight-leading ImageMagick image dropped a row. It now uses a seeded image and asserts the property that matters (the reading is right, or the balance checks flag it).

doc_friction.issue: Every open item in ai-bookkeeper's next: needs a real outside input or a blocked state tax host (all 7 state sites probed returned 000). The buildable slice had to come from the README's 'not modelled' list (scanned statement PDFs), which the flagship row does not point to.
ai-bookkeeper next: was at 1970 of 2000 characters; adding one clause put it at exactly 2000, so the next run that lands a slice has to cut text rather than add.

deviations.why: The flagship's listed items all need real inputs (bank books, state pages, payroll reports) that a cloud session cannot reach, and the 'BUILDABLE HERE' hint was absent.
deviations.did: Took a gap the README lists as not modelled (scanned statement PDFs) and measured it on synthetic scans made by a seeded generator. It is labelled synthetic everywhere.
deviations.result: Landed a working CLI route; 36 of 40 synthetic scans read perfectly and 1 of 40 is silently wrong. A real bank scan is still wanted.

notes: Verification: run_venture_tests.py ai-bookkeeper ok (38.8s); eval/pasted-roundtrip.mjs 1094 rows 0 wrong; eval/scanned-statements.mjs --n 40 (seed 7, tesseract 5.3.4) gave 694/703 rows and 36/40 perfect with repair and a second reading, vs 691 and 32 with one reading and no repair, on the same images; CLI import of a scanned PDF checked by hand (a page misread by --psm 6 was recovered by the --psm 4 reading). tesseract-ocr was installed with apt in the session. No agent doc in docs/reports: the README section carries what the next run needs. GitHub showed no check runs on the PR, so verification is local: venture-preflight.mjs ai-bookkeeper clean; run_workflow_locally ventures-tests.yml 5/5 run steps passed (3 uses: steps not run); conflict-markers-ci, portfolio-validate and prompts-ci passed; check_md_links, check_code_refs, venture_live_links, readme_titles and control_plane_guard --check-coverage all exit 0; check_post_frontmatter ok. The agent-cross-review and portfolio-pages deploy jobs were not run locally.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an engineer building an OCR import route with balance-chain repair, a synthetic scan benchmark and reader fixes, about a day and a half

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
